title: Topic 5: Feelings & States - Vocabulary
description: Core words for feelings & states: happy, sad, tired, hungry, thirsty, cold. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Say how you feel; ask others how they feel
introductionText:
happy = you smile!  |  sad = you are not happy
tired = you need sleep  |  hungry = you need food
thirsty = you need water  |  cold = brrr!
+ phrase bank: How are you? | Are you tired? |
Yes, I am / No, I am not

grammarBlocks.title: FULL TO BE PARADIGM completed - adds WE ARE / THEY ARE to I/
grammarBlocks.explanation: FULL TO BE PARADIGM completed - adds WE ARE / THEY ARE to I/you (T1-2) and he/she (T3-4). Questions + short answers with feelings: Are you tired? Yes, I am / No, I am not.
patterns: we are / they are (paradigm now complete)
Are you...? Yes, I am / No, I am not

questions.question: It is 11 at night and you need sleep. You are ___.
Tap the missing word: Water, please! I am very ___.
Tap the missing word: Brrr! I am very ___ today.
Which word is NOT a feeling?
Grammar: My sister and I ___ hungry. My parents ___ tired.
Grammar: A: ___ you cold? B: No, I ___ not.

explanations.A1-T05-VOC-Q1: Hungry = you need food. Thirsty = you need water.
explanations.A1-T05-VOC-Q4: Cold = brrr! You need a warm room.
explanations.A1-T05-VOC-Q5: Morning is a time of day (Topic 1) - not a feeling.
explanations.A1-T05-VOC-Q6: How are you? asks about feelings - answer with I am + feeling.
explanations.A1-T05-VOC-Q7: My sister and I = WE -> are. My parents = THEY -> are.
explanations.A1-T05-VOC-Q8: Are you...? -> Yes, I am / No, I am not.

teacherNotes: Source: tasilla_topic05_feelings_states.txt, Lesson 5.1. Pass 70%. All exercises tap-to-answer.
